## Purpose
Describe the change and whether it affects reproduction, documentation, or an extension of the benchmark.

## Reference-study integrity
- [ ] The v2.1.1 reference implementation is unchanged.
- [ ] The change modifies the reference implementation and is clearly identified as a modification.

## Reproducibility
- [ ] I ran the relevant reproduction checks.
- [ ] I documented any changed outputs or configuration.

## Scientific claims
- [ ] The change does not overstate synthetic recovery as full benchmark validation.
- [ ] Positive, null, and negative results are reported without selective omission.
